variants.title: Meissner effect by AC susceptibility: a niobium-type sphere (illustrative)
variants.sample: Niobium-type sphere of radius 20 um, Tc about 9 K (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.method: two-coil mutual inductance, chi' and chi'' against T
variants.unknown: Tc and the London penetration depth
variants.note: A larger sphere with a lower Tc: the shielding is almost perfect (f close to 1) so the penetration depth is a small correction. Radius and superfluid density are illustrative.

source.title: Unsourced / illustrative sample constants
source.note: Tc about 9 K is the order of magnitude for niobium; the sphere radius and ns are chosen for the lab, not looked up.
